behaviouralQuestions.title: A time you took initiative (example)
behaviouralQuestions.prompt: Tell me about a time you took the initiative.
guidance: Pick a situation where nobody asked you to act. Be clear about what you decided and why.

steps.label: Action
steps.hint: What you did, in the first person.

steps.label: Result
steps.hint: The outcome, with numbers if you can.

checklist: Says what I did, not only what we did
